title: Volato Group, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 17, 2026 disclosing the dismissal of its independent registered public accounting firm Elliott Davis, PLLC and the engagement of TAAD, LLP as its new auditor. Elliott Davis's audit report for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 contained an explanatory paragraph expressing substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. The Company also disclosed material weaknesses in internal controls in its Annual Report on Form 10-K filed March 12, 2026.
key_points: Auditor change: Elliott Davis, PLLC dismissed; TAAD, LLP engaged as new independent registered public accounting firm
